name: Purchase Invoice Payment Cycle (Multiple)
query:
SELECT
    -- Purchase Invoice Fields
    pi.name AS "ID:Link/Purchase Invoice:150",
    pi.supplier_name AS "Supplier::200",
    pi.custom_circuit_id AS "Circuit ID::150",
    DATE_FORMAT(pi.posting_date, '%%d-%%m-%%Y') AS "Posting Date::120",
    pi.custom_site_name AS "Site Name::200",
    pi.bill_no AS "Supplier Inv No::150",

    -- Added Fields
    pi.custom_payment_catogery AS "Payment Catogery::150",
    DATE_FORMAT(pi.custom_dutation_from, '%%d-%%m-%%Y') AS "Duration From::120",
    DATE_FORMAT(pi.custom_duration_to, '%%d-%%m-%%Y') AS "Duration To::120",

    pi.grand_total AS "Grand Total:Currency:120",
    pi.rounded_total AS "Rounded Total:Currency:120",
    pi.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding Amt:Currency:150",
    pi.status AS "Status::120",
    pi.custom_lms_id AS "LMS ID::150",

    -- Purchase Invoice Item Fields
    pii.circuit_id AS "Item Circuit ID::150",
    pii.site_name AS "Item Site Name::200",
    pii.lms_id AS "Item LMS ID::150",
    pii.item_name AS "Item Name::200",
    pii.rate AS "Item Rate:Currency:120",
    pii.qty AS "Item Qty:Float:100",
    pii.amount AS "Item Amount:Currency:120"

FROM
    `tabPurchase Invoice` pi

LEFT JOIN
    `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
ON
    pii.parent = pi.name

WHERE
    pi.docstatus = 1

ORDER BY
    pi.posting_date DESC,
    pi.name DESC
